note: Simple words for kids. Each technical English line from lesson.json, with its simple English (en) and simple Spanish (es) version. Shown when the Simple | Technical switch is on Simple. A line missing here shows as it is. Wording rules and glossary: tools/simple-words.md.

Let two slow oscillators drive the 4051.en: Let two slow oscillators control the 4051 chip, which picks one path at a time. First they step through lights. Then they step a third oscillator through different filters.
Let two slow oscillators drive the 4051.es: Deja que dos osciladores lentos controlen el chip 4051, que elige un camino a la vez. Primero recorren unas luces. Luego pasan un tercer oscilador por distintos filtros, uno tras otro.

Connect the power rails on both sides wi.en: At the right end of the board, add two wires that join the power rows along the top edge to the power rows along the bottom edge.
Connect the power rails on both sides wi.es: En el extremo derecho del tablero, agrega dos cables que unan las filas de energía del borde de arriba con las del borde de abajo.

Place the 40106 chip across the center g.en: Put the 40106 chip across the groove in the middle of the board. Then add its two power wires: one to plus (+) and one to minus (−).
Place the 40106 chip across the center g.es: Pon el chip 40106 sobre la ranura del centro del tablero. Luego agrega sus dos cables de energía: uno a más (+) y otro a menos (−).

Add two short red jumpers below the chip.en: Add two short red wires below the chip.
Add two short red jumpers below the chip.es: Agrega dos cables rojos cortos debajo del chip.

Add a trimmer next to the chip..en: Add a knob next to the chip.
Add a trimmer next to the chip..es: Agrega una perilla junto al chip.

Add two short red jumpers above the chip.en: Add two short red wires above the chip.
Add two short red jumpers above the chip.es: Agrega dos cables rojos cortos arriba del chip.

Add a second trimmer at the top..en: Add a second knob at the top.

Add a large capacitor for each oscillato.en: Add a big capacitor for each oscillator.
Add a large capacitor for each oscillato.es: Agrega un capacitor grande para cada oscilador.

Add a resistor from each oscillator's ou.en: For each oscillator, add a resistor from its output leg (where the signal comes out) toward the middle.
Add a resistor from each oscillator's ou.es: Para cada oscilador, agrega una resistencia desde su pata de salida (por donde sale la señal) hacia el centro.

Add a red LED and a green LED at the end.en: Add a red light and a green light at the ends of the resistors.
Add a red LED and a green LED at the end.es: Agrega una luz roja y una luz verde en las puntas de las resistencias.

Clip the battery connector onto the 9V b.en: Snap the battery clip onto the 9-volt battery.
Clip the battery connector onto the 9V b.es: Encaja el conector de la batería en la batería de 9 voltios.

Plug in the battery: the two LEDs blink.en: Plug in the battery. The two lights blink at different speeds.
Plug in the battery: the two LEDs blink.es: Conecta la batería. Las dos luces parpadean a distintas velocidades.

Place the 4051 chip in the middle and ad.en: Put the 4051 chip in the middle. Add its two power wires: one to plus (+) and one to minus (−). It links one of eight channels at a time.
Place the 4051 chip in the middle and ad.es: Pon el chip 4051 en el centro. Luego agrega sus dos cables de energía: uno a más (+) y otro a menos (−). Conecta uno de sus ocho canales a la vez.

Add one jumper above the 4051 and two mo.en: Add one wire above the 4051. Then add two more short wires below it. Now three wires sit side by side.
Add one jumper above the 4051 and two mo.es: Agrega un cable arriba del 4051. Luego agrega dos cables cortos más debajo. Así quedan tres cables uno al lado del otro.

Run a yellow wire from the first oscilla.en: Add a yellow wire from the first oscillator to one of the 4051's legs that choose the channel.
Run a yellow wire from the first oscilla.es: Agrega un cable amarillo desde el primer oscilador hasta una de las patas del 4051 que eligen el canal.

Run a second yellow wire from the other.en: Add a second yellow wire from the other oscillator to the next leg that chooses the channel.
Run a second yellow wire from the other.es: Agrega un segundo cable amarillo desde el otro oscilador hasta la siguiente pata que elige el canal.

Add a red LED to the first channel..en: Add a red light to the first channel.
Add a red LED to the first channel..es: Agrega una luz roja al primer canal.

Add three more LEDs to the next channels.en: Add three more lights to the next channels.
Add three more LEDs to the next channels.es: Agrega tres luces más a los canales siguientes.

Plug the battery back in at the right en.en: Plug the battery back in at the right end.
Plug the battery back in at the right en.es: Vuelve a conectar la batería en el extremo derecho.

Add a resistor from the 4051's common pi.en: Add a resistor from the 4051's common leg to the minus (−) row. Now one light at a time turns on as the oscillators choose the channel.
Add a resistor from the 4051's common pi.es: Agrega una resistencia desde la pata común del 4051 hasta la fila de menos (−). Ahora se enciende una luz a la vez mientras los osciladores eligen el canal.

Remove the resistor at the bottom..en: Take out the resistor at the bottom.

Add two short red jumpers at the bottom.en: Add two short red wires at the bottom for a third oscillator.
Add two short red jumpers at the bottom.es: Agrega dos cables rojos cortos abajo para un tercer oscilador.

Add a third trimmer, a large capacitor a.en: Add a third knob, a big capacitor and a short yellow wire.
Add a third trimmer, a large capacitor a.es: Agrega una tercera perilla, un capacitor grande y un cable amarillo corto.

Add a resistor from the third oscillator.en: Add a resistor from the third oscillator's output leg (where the signal comes out) to the 4051's common leg.
Add a resistor from the third oscillator.es: Agrega una resistencia desde la pata de salida del tercer oscilador (por donde sale la señal) hasta la pata común del 4051.

Take the resistor out to compare..en: Take the resistor out to compare.

Put it back, then turn the new trimmer a.en: Put it back. Then turn the new knob and watch how the lights change.
Put it back, then turn the new trimmer a.es: Vuelve a ponerla. Luego gira la nueva perilla y mira cómo cambian las luces.

Stepped low-pass clicks.en: Clicks, step by step, through filters that let low sounds through
Stepped low-pass clicks.es: Clics paso a paso por filtros que dejan pasar los sonidos graves

Add a resistor from the first 4051 chann.en: Add a resistor from the 4051's first channel to a shared row.
Add a resistor from the first 4051 chann.es: Agrega una resistencia desde el primer canal del 4051 hasta una fila compartida.

Add a second resistor, a different value.en: Add a second resistor from the next channel. Use one with a different value.
Add a second resistor, a different value.es: Agrega una segunda resistencia desde el canal siguiente. Usa una de otro valor.

Add a fourth resistor: a ladder of diffe.en: Add a fourth resistor. Now the resistors make a ladder of different values.
Add a fourth resistor: a ladder of diffe.es: Agrega una cuarta resistencia. Ahora las resistencias forman una escalera de valores distintos.

Add a jumper across the center gap from.en: Add a wire from the shared row, across the groove in the middle of the board.
Add a jumper across the center gap from.es: Agrega un cable desde la fila compartida, cruzando la ranura del centro del tablero.

Add a small capacitor to ground. With th.en: Add a small capacitor to the minus (−) row. Together with the chosen resistor, it makes a filter that lets low sounds through.
Add a small capacitor to ground. With th.es: Agrega un capacitor pequeño a la fila de menos (−). Junto con la resistencia elegida, forma un filtro que deja pasar los sonidos graves.

Add a red jumper toward the audio jack..en: Add a red wire toward the jack.
Add a red jumper toward the audio jack..es: Agrega un cable rojo hacia el conector de audio.

Add a ground jumper from the top rail fo.en: Add a wire from the minus (−) row along the top edge, for the jack.
Add a ground jumper from the top rail fo.es: Agrega un cable desde la fila de menos (−) del borde de arriba, para el conector de audio.

Connect the third oscillator to the 4051.en: Connect the third oscillator to the 4051's common leg. At each step, its clicks go through a different resistor. So they sound brighter or duller.
Connect the third oscillator to the 4051.es: Conecta el tercer oscilador a la pata común del 4051. En cada paso, sus clics pasan por otra resistencia. Por eso suenan más brillantes o más apagados.

Stepped low-pass tones.en: Tones, step by step, through filters that let low sounds through
Stepped low-pass tones.es: Tonos paso a paso por filtros que dejan pasar los sonidos graves

Remove the third oscillator's large capa.en: Take out the third oscillator's big capacitor.
Remove the third oscillator's large capa.es: Quita el capacitor grande del tercer oscilador.

Put a smaller capacitor in its place, so.en: Put a smaller capacitor in its place. Now the third oscillator makes a tone.
Put a smaller capacitor in its place, so.es: Pon un capacitor más pequeño en su lugar. Así el tercer oscilador hace un tono.

Plug the orange wire back in and listen.en: Plug the orange wire back in. Listen to the tone step through the filters.
Plug the orange wire back in and listen.es: Vuelve a enchufar el cable naranja. Escucha cómo el tono pasa por los filtros, uno tras otro.

Stepped band-pass tones.en: Tones, step by step, through filters that cut low and high sounds
Stepped band-pass tones.es: Tonos paso a paso por filtros que cortan los sonidos graves y agudos

Add a small capacitor after the third os.en: Add a small capacitor after the third oscillator.
Add a small capacitor after the third os.es: Agrega un capacitor pequeño después del tercer oscilador.

Add a fourth trimmer next to the 4051..en: Add a fourth knob next to the 4051.
Add a fourth trimmer next to the 4051..es: Agrega una cuarta perilla junto al 4051.

Add a short jumper below it..en: Add a short wire below it.
Add a short jumper below it..es: Agrega un cable corto debajo de la perilla.

Plug the orange wire back in, from the f.en: Plug the orange wire back in, from the far side of the new capacitor to the 4051's common leg. The capacitor and knob cut low sounds. The resistors cut high sounds. Together they make a filter that lets only middle sounds through. Turn the new knob to move that middle range.
Plug the orange wire back in, from the f.es: Vuelve a enchufar el cable naranja, desde el otro lado del nuevo capacitor hasta la pata común del 4051. El capacitor y la perilla cortan los sonidos graves. Las resistencias cortan los agudos. Juntos forman un filtro que solo deja pasar los sonidos del medio. Gira la nueva perilla para mover ese rango del medio.
